change_detection_contract.new_identity: Authoritative TRANSHISSEQ not present in persistent TRANSFER_TITLE memory for the parcel.
change_detection_contract.metadata_completion: Same TRANSHISSEQ exists in memory but authoritative source now supplies factual metadata absent from the stored row.
change_detection_contract.unchanged: Same TRANSHISSEQ with no newly supplied authoritative metadata detectable from preserved ledger columns.
change_detection_contract.rule: Static historical context alone never becomes a change event.

evidence_value_contract.principle: A property receives new research attention only from a genuine factual delta or an explicitly preserved unresolved fact; static history alone is not attention.

positive_control.purpose: Prove one genuine new factual identity becomes one explainable research-attention item without persistence, promotion, scoring, contact, or outreach.
